newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Cahaya Kalbar revises up 1997 target.
newsitem.headline: Cahaya Kalbar revises up 1997 target.

text.p: Indonesian cocoa processor and edible oil producer PT Cahaya Kalbar said on Monday it had revised up its 1997 and 1998 net target to 28 billion and 37 billion rupiah respectively.
The company said in a statement that it targeted to book total sales of 152 billion and 193 billion rupiah in 1997 and 1998 respectively.
The company did not provide its previous targets.
It posted a net profit of 17 billion rupiah in 1996 against 6.6 billion rupiah in 1995.

Cahaya Kalbar's corporate secretary Robertus Sampara Lie said that the company planned to establish a new plant in Cikarang, an eastern suburb of Jakarta, to meet increasing demand in the edible oil market.
"Total investment for the plant is about 60 billion rupiah," he said adding it would start to contribute to earnings by the end of 1998.
